name: @rubric/engine
description: rubrik. — skill verification engine and web app. Long-running Node HTTP server, no build step.

comments.why-one-dependency: The server, router, assessment pipeline and UI are all standard library. `pg` is the only dependency because PostgreSQL needs a driver; with DATABASE_URL unset the engine uses a JSON file store and needs no install at all.
comments.removed-in-v1: next, react, react-dom, typescript and @types/* were declared but no Next.js app ever existed (no app/ or pages/ directory, no next-env.d.ts) — `next build` could never have succeeded. groq-sdk and zod were unused: providers are reached with fetch via engine/ai/, which is what makes them interchangeable. ethers and solc belonged to the on-chain credential work, which is out of the V1 flow; engine/web3.js already degrades without ethers, and the deploy/compile scripts need `npm install ethers solc` if that work resumes.
